docs.title: ⚡ SYNAPSE - Hub de Veille Technologique & IA
docs.text: Welcome to the official documentation for SYNAPSE, an intelligent local tech watch and curation ecosystem powered by Google Vertex AI Gemini and a native Chrome Extension (Manifest V3).

docs.title: 🚀 Key Highlights
docs.text:
• Single-Click Ingestion: Save web articles or LinkedIn posts with full-text body extraction and automatic base domain detection.
  • Dual Reading Mode: Switch effortlessly between the Full Article (📖 Lire) and AI Summary (✨ Résumé IA).
  • Interactive Article Q&A: Chat directly with any single article using Gemini 2.5 Flash, with automatic web search context fallback when requested.
  • Global Chatbot: Query your entire curation knowledge base in natural language.
  • Weekly Newsletter Digest: Generate beautifully formatted Markdown digests categorized by topic in 1 click.

docs.title: 📐 Architecture & API Reference
docs.text: SYNAPSE is built with a modular local-first architecture.

docs.title: 🔌 API Endpoints
docs.text: Method Endpoint Description GET / Serves static SPA dashboard (index.html). GET /api/stats Returns total articles, favorites count, category count. GET /api/articles Filter articles by category, tag, search query, favorite. POST /api/articles Creates or updates an article entry. GET /api/categories Returns category counts. POST /api/extract Scrapes metadata from a given URL. POST /api/ai/enrich/{id} Triggers live Gemini 2.5 Flash summary & tagging. POST /api/ai/chat Global Knowledge Base RAG Chatbot. POST /api/ai/article-chat Article Q&A chatbot with Web Search fallback. POST /api/ai/newsletter Generates weekly Markdown digest.

docs.title: 🧩 Chrome Extension (Manifest V3)
docs.text: The SYNAPSE Chrome Extension allows users to capture any web article, news post, or LinkedIn update into their local SYNAPSE hub in 1 click.

docs.title: 🛠️ Features & Architecture
docs.text:
1. Auto Domain Detection: Automatically extracts and formats the clean source domain (e.g. Spotify Engineering, Full Stack Data Lab, Github.com).
  2. Full Page Body Extraction: Scrapes the complete multi-paragraph text body from <article> or <main> elements, stripping navigation, scripts, and footers.
  3. LinkedIn Native Integration: Injects a compact bookmark button 🔖 cleanly into LinkedIn feed action bars.
  4. Technical URN Protection: Extracts LinkedIn technical URNs (urn:li:activity:... or urn:li:share:...) as true permalinks to prevent body link hijacking.
  5. Background Proxying: Bypasses browser Mixed Content / CORS restrictions by relaying local HTTP requests (http://localhost:8000) through background.js.

docs.title: 📥 Installation
docs.text:
1. Open chrome://extensions in Google Chrome.
  2. Enable Developer mode in the top-right corner.
  3. Click Load unpacked and select the chrome-extension/ directory.

docs.title: 🖥️ Web Dashboard & AI Features
docs.text: The SYNAPSE Web Dashboard (http://localhost:8000) provides a modern dark glassmorphism SPA interface for viewing, reading, synthesizing, and chatting with your curated knowledge.

docs.title: 1. Dual Reading Mode
docs.text: Every article card includes two distinct triggers: - 📖 Lire: Opens the Reader Modal displaying the full multi-paragraph article body (art.content). - ✨ Résumé IA: Opens the Reader Modal in summary mode, displaying a 3-5 bullet point synthesis in French with bolded key terms. If a summary does not exist, Gemini 2.5 Flash generates it on the fly in real-time.

docs.title: 2. Interactive Article Q&A Chatbot
docs.text: Located at the bottom of the Reader Modal: - Allows asking questions specific to the article currently being read. - Web Search Integration: Automatically performs live DuckDuckGo web searches when the query asks for recent facts, competitors, or external context, adding a 🌐 Recherche Web badge to the response. - Delivers succinct, bulleted answers.

docs.title: 3. Global Knowledge Base Chatbot
docs.text: Accessible via the sidebar Chatbot tab: - Analyzes the full corpus of saved articles in SQLite. - Provides cited answers linking back to specific articles and authors in your watch feed.

docs.title: 4. Weekly Newsletter Digest
docs.text: Accessible via the Newsletter Hebdo tab: - Groups articles saved over the last 7 days by topic. - Generates a structured Markdown newsletter ready for email or publication.
